changes.comment: BREAKING: Stop authoring channel MCP descriptors in the Feishu provider. The package now exposes only the static Feishu tool catalog plus reply/react/list_chat_bots handlers; Dreamux core renders the channel-mcp descriptor, admin socket, caller, team, and leader routing args.
Clear the optimistic Feishu inbound received reaction when core submission throws before delivery, preventing a stale received marker on failed inbound turns.
